description: Stormwater Pits is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. This dataset captures all stormwater pits throughout the City of Melbourne. A stormwater pit is designed to hold water so that the drainage system can process the run off and not be overloaded. This dataset can be used in conjunction with the drainpipe dataset The litter trap dataset and also the pumping station dataset. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are asset, pits, storm, water. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
